propositions: Existing deterministic repair and sentinel extraction logic in structured.parse_structured must be callable through a Pydantic TextOutput function that raises ModelRetry on retryable StructuredOutputError

Provider stop/refusal safety checks from structured.check_response must run before output parsing via an after_model_request capability hook that raises terminal UnretryableOutputError without prompting Pydantic retry
The adapter preserves the exact Rebar StructuredOutputError object in the ModelRetry exception cause chain so error context is not lost
Refusal and content-filter responses abort after one model call by raising UnretryableOutputError, preventing Pydantic from scheduling retry prompts
The adapter adds no new retry loop, provider selection, usage projection, or persistence logic beyond wrapping existing pure parser and guard functions
